source_validation.scope: source geometry, contacts and explicit opening hosts

assumptions: Correction cell rings represent physical source spaces with horizontal floor/ceiling boundaries.
Contacts describe adjacency, not traversability or EnergyPlus surface pairing.
Only explicit openings are represented; absent observations do not establish a solid wall.
Source boundary identity follows cell identity and ring order; topology edits need identity migration.
Interior corridor door heights (2.1m) are assumed; no elevation shows internal door heights.

Exterior door head height 2.4m derived from South_view.png dimension chain (600,900,1500->head=2400); applied also to the West entrance door by similarity, not independently confirmed by West_view chain segmentation.
Partition and corridor wall thickness not modelled (compiler centreline convention); only exterior envelope carries the 240mm wall per drawing label.
Plan spaces were compiled deterministically from the declared footprint and physical partition segments; no snapping, extension, clipping, or inferred partition was applied.

unresolved: Corridor door widths simplified to ~900mm/1200mm bands from noisy overlapping profile gaps near partition junctions; exact leaf count/width (single vs double door) at each corridor entry not fully resolved.

East and West exterior wall full opening inventory (besides the identified west entrance door) not yet cross-checked against East_view.png; East facade shows only windows on elevation, consistent with no door found on east wall in plan.
Pixel-to-world calibration was supplied by the caller and was not independently verified.

scope.actual_openings: only explicit built source openings are inventoried

reused_calibration.basis: 1F: x_anchors and y_anchors from outer wall faces measured against the '15000' and '8000' overall dimension chains (west face px425=world0, east face px1815=world15000; south outer face px1088=world0, north outer face px347=world8000). Exterior wall representative plane = outer face for footprint; interior partitions/corridor walls use observed single-line centreline pixel positions from view_pixel_profile (gray band detection, profile_001..004). Partition1 centreline px888 (world~5000), partition2 centreline px1352 (world~10000). Corridor north wall centreline px618, south wall centreline px804, matching the '3000,250,1500,250,3000' vertical dimension chain (corridor clear 1500mm, walls ~town of building). Openings measured from wall-gap intervals in the same profiles.

scope.endpoint_selection: exact original image name and linked wall floor

limits: Endpoint pixels are the declared original-image evidence and are drawn without inferred movement.
Tangential range and normal displacement are conditional on the caller-supplied axis-aligned calibration.
A dimension extension-line tick may legitimately lie outside its linked finite wall segment; this is a spatial fact, not an error or correctness verdict.
This view does not inspect pixels, choose a host wall, or mutate source geometry or evidence.

input_view_status.note: Only this run's hash-bound view_image returns are counted. Other image tools, workers and prior runs are outside this scope. A returned image is not proof of examination, complete coverage, correct interpretation or applied heights. Use supplied relevant elevations to check each floor's opening heights; do not transfer a typical height to an unexamined opening family.

room_use_review.next_action: Read room_types and edits, inspect original room interiors, then use revise_bim/set_space_role to choose a plausible use, including a reasonable inference from building context. Prefer a broad listed type over unknown; avoid spending excessive effort distinguishing similar plausible uses. Read remaining cells with read_candidate_items; preserve physical partitions.
room_use_review.interpretation: Counts cover structured role_evidence only, not semantic correctness. Legacy source_refs may contain other evidence. Unknown remains a fallback when no defensible listed use fits; it is not a preferred response to ambiguity.

current_claim_state.note: Current numerical/context consistency only; neither retained nor confirmed means drawing truth.

height_coverage.note: Coverage means a current adopted z binding, not proof that the drawing or BIM is correct. Inference and declared values do not count as located-image height evidence.
